facts.text: In 2025 the Port of Saguenay handled more than 1 million tonnes of cargo at Grande-Anse, welcomed 96 merchant ships and saw more than 60,000 cruise passengers disembark at La Baie.
Promotion Saguenay supported 423 business projects in 2025, generating $72.5 million in investment, and hosted 81 business, convention and sporting events worth $5.8 million in direct spending.
The Quebec government is investing $10.3 million at the Port of Saguenay to start work on an industrial-port zone, opening access to more than 1,200 hectares of industrial land.
The aluminium industry generates over 30,000 direct, indirect and induced jobs in Saguenay–Lac-Saint-Jean.
Rio Tinto is building a CAN$1.4 billion aluminium smelter in the region, adding up to 1,000 construction jobs at peak to the more than 4,000 employees it already has in Saguenay–Lac-Saint-Jean.

overview: Saguenay counted 144,723 residents in the 2021 Census, living in 67,522 occupied private dwellings across 1,124.63 square kilometres. That makes it one of the most spread-out cities in Quebec, with distinct centres in Chicoutimi, Jonquière and La Baie, so a business rarely serves the whole city from one location.

The economy rests on aluminium, the port and a growing cruise trade. Rio Tinto is a major employer, the Port of Saguenay is expanding into an industrial-port zone, and the local development agency backs hundreds of projects a year. A local firm competes in a mature, almost entirely French-speaking market where trust and repeat business matter more than volume.

byService.lead-generation: Spread over 1,124.63 square kilometres, Saguenay splits into separate boroughs, so lead generation should run distinct campaigns for Chicoutimi, Jonquière and La Baie rather than one citywide push.
byService.seo: In Saguenay, SEO means ranking for French queries that name the borough, because residents of a city of 144,723 still search for services in Chicoutimi or Jonquière, not Saguenay.
byService.website-development: A Saguenay website should list each borough location clearly, explain industrial and marine services in French, and load quickly for a market with many older homeowners and industrial buyers.
byService.branding: Branding in Saguenay works when it reflects the region's aluminium and fjord identity, positioning a business as a long-term local partner in a market of 67,522 households.
